$comment: Why each entry of the harness knip.json ignore lists exists (quality-gates check-gate-wiring rule knip-ignores). knip.json equals the canonical file plus the harness-only keys ignoreDependencies and ignoreBinaries (verify-templates keeps them on --sync-harness). The ten agent-folder ignore reasons are the canonical ones, copied from quality-gates' templates/contracts/knip-ignores.json; the rest are the harness's own.

ignore.skills/**: skills vendored or installed at the repo root: their templates and fixtures import packages the app never installs, and knip's Jest plugin falls back to Jest's default test glob, so without this entry check:unused fails on skill files
ignore..agents/**: skills installed for an agent under .agents/: their templates and fixtures import packages the app never installs, and knip's Jest plugin falls back to Jest's default test glob, so without this entry check:unused fails on skill files

ignoreDependencies.@formatjs/cli: scripts/i18n/verify-catalogs.ts (i18n-strings-and-catalogs) resolves the FormatJS CLI with createRequire(...).resolve and runs the file, which knip cannot see; npm run i18n:verify needs it.
ignoreDependencies.@hookform/resolvers: Pre-installed canonical stack package (forms: the valibot resolver for react-hook-form): verify-templates copies skill templates that import it into a temp copy of the harness, so it must be installed; the harness app code does not import it yet. Delete this entry once harness code imports it (knip then prints a configuration hint).
